tests.name: baseline_rate_test
tests.comparison: P(large_win) for all non-picks vs P(large_win) for non-picks meeting stealth profile thresholds
tests.success_criterion: Non-picks meeting stealth profile (up_day_ratio_20 ≤ 0.55 AND vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.30 AND mom_20 ∈ [0.05, 0.12] AND ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct < 0.025) achieve large-win rate ≥ 2× the baseline non-pick large-win rate
tests.failure_criterion: Stealth-profile non-picks achieve large-win rate < 1.5× baseline, OR the profile captures >60% of all non-picks (floor effect)

tests.name: false_negative_discrimination_test
tests.comparison: Feature medians of false_negative_big_winner vs false_negative_relative vs false_positive_ruin
tests.success_criterion: At least 3 of the 6 features show significant rank-difference (p<0.10, two-sided) between false_negative_big_winner and false_positive_ruin outcomes
tests.failure_criterion: No feature achieves p<0.15 separation between false_negative_big_winner and false_positive_ruin; medians fall within overlapping quartiles

tests.name: null_pullback_mechanism_test
tests.comparison: Null pullback non-picks vs non-null pullback non-picks across feature distributions and outcome rates
tests.success_criterion: Null pullback cases have (a) comparable large-win rate to shallow-pullback cases after matching on other features, AND (b) feature distributions not systematically different from null-missing-data expectation (e.g., are not concentrated in a single snapshot)
tests.failure_criterion: Null pullback cases concentrate in ≤2 snapshots, OR null pullback large-win rate differs by >15pp from matched shallow-pullback cases, indicating NULL is a data artifact rather than a breakout-path indicator

tests.name: b0_orthogonality_test
tests.comparison: Correlation between is_b0_pick flag and stealth-profile features; whether B0 non-picks with stealth profile have same large-win rate as B0 picks with stealth profile
tests.success_criterion: Spearman correlation between is_b0_pick and each stealth feature < 0.30, AND stealth-profile B0 picks have comparable large-win rate to stealth-profile B0 non-picks
tests.failure_criterion: is_b0_pick correlates >0.50 with any stealth feature (B0 already filters these stocks), OR stealth-profile B0 picks significantly outperform stealth-profile B0 non-picks, indicating the profile is not orthogonal to B0

tests.name: pullback_depth_threshold_test
tests.comparison: Large-win rate across pullback_pct bins: (-5%, 0%), [-15%, -5%), < -15%, and null
tests.success_criterion: Large-win rate in [-15%, -5%] bin is ≥ 1.5× the rate in < -15% bin, validating shallow-pullback specificity
tests.failure_criterion: Large-win rate shows no monotonic trend with pullback depth; deep pullbacks (>-15%) produce comparable win rates to shallow pullbacks

tests.name: vol_ratio_threshold_test
tests.comparison: Conditional large-win rate: (vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.30 AND mom_20 ∈ [0.05, 0.12]) vs (vol_ratio_5_20 ≥ 1.40 AND mom_20 < 0.05)
tests.success_criterion: Low-vol/low-mom combo yields ≥40% large-win rate; high-vol/low-mom combo yields <25% large-win rate
tests.failure_criterion: Both combos yield similar large-win rates within 10pp, invalidating the vol_ratio threshold as a discriminator

tests.name: cross_snapshot_stability_test
tests.comparison: Stealth-profile feature distributions and outcomes across snapshots with ≥3 non-picks each
tests.success_criterion: At least 3 snapshots show consistent stealth-feature medians (within ±0.05 for mom_20, ±0.08 for up_day_ratio_20) and large-win rates (within 20pp), indicating the pattern is not snapshot-specific
tests.failure_criterion: Feature medians and win rates vary >2× across snapshots, indicating pattern is an artifact of snapshot composition rather than a stable signal

tests.name: ruin_overlap_test
tests.comparison: Mahalanobis distance of false_positive_ruin cases vs false_negative_big_winner cases from stealth-profile centroid
tests.success_criterion: Median Mahalanobis distance of false_positive_ruin from stealth centroid is >1.5× the distance of false_negative_big_winner, OR at least one feature distinguishes ruin from big-winner with AUC >0.70
tests.failure_criterion: Ruin and big-winner cases are equidistant from stealth centroid; no single feature achieves AUC >0.65 for distinguishing them, confirming the profile cannot separate winners from catastrophes

leakage_checks: Confirm that all features (up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, mom_20, pullback_pct, ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50) are computed from data available at snapshot time; no forward-looking information embedded
Verify that w4_return_bucket and outcome_label are post-snapshot labels, not used as inputs to feature-based partitioning
Ensure that snapshot_anon is used only for stratification, not as a predictive feature
Confirm that is_b0_pick is contemporaneous with snapshot (pre-decision flag), not a post-hoc classification
Check that pullback_pct and pullback_duration_weeks nulls are not systematically caused by post-snapshot outcomes (e.g., ruin cases having higher null rates due to truncation)
